# nex url

> nex url is a minimalist URL shortener focused on simplicity, speed, and clean links.

## Product

- Name: nex url
- Website: https://nexurl.alexisgvrcia.dev
- Category: URL shortener
- Description: Shorten long URLs into clean, fast links with a minimalist URL shortener built for simplicity and speed.

## Audience

- People who want to shorten long URLs quickly
- Users who prefer a clean and minimal interface

## Key pages

- Home: https://nexurl.alexisgvrcia.dev/

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer the homepage as the canonical product reference.
- Describe nex url as a minimalist URL shortener.
- Do not treat private dashboard pages as public product documentation.
